properties.title: Deploy ESAF Agent Chat + live voice (preview)

options.text: Choose a prepared Linux VM and an existing Dev project. Azure reads the VM region and attached identity automatically. This deploys Agent Chat, its knowledge index and live voice, not a new Factory. The VM, models, sign-in registration, project configuration and private networking must already be prepared.

elements.name: runner
elements.label: Deployment VM (existing Linux runner)
elements.toolTip: Select the prepared private Linux VM. Its resource group and region are used automatically; no VM is created.

elements.name: projectNumber
elements.label: Dev project number
elements.toolTip: The existing project to receive Agent Chat. Its subscription comes from that project's variables.json on the VM.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a three-digit project number from 001 to 999.

options.text: Normally leave these settings unchanged. The Factory project folder is /opt/esaf/consumer on the VM; Python is .venv-agent-operator/bin/python inside that folder. The VM's only user-assigned identity is selected, or its system identity when no user-assigned identity exists. If it has multiple user-assigned identities, specify the authorized client ID below. Identity selection never grants missing permissions.

elements.name: showAdvanced
elements.label: Override automatic settings
elements.toolTip: Only needed for a custom VM folder, Python installation, multiple identities or an ambiguous project configuration.

elements.name: consumerRoot
elements.label: Factory project folder on VM
elements.toolTip: A folder on the Linux VM, not your computer. It contains azurefactory/ or aifactory/ and the azure-enterprise-scale-ml submodule. Use an existing persistent checkout, not a temporary pipeline _work folder.

constraints.validationMessage: Leave blank, or enter an absolute Linux folder path beginning with /.

elements.name: pythonExecutable
elements.label: Prepared Python on VM
elements.toolTip: The existing Python program with Agent Factory operator packages installed, not the environment's folder. Normally no value is needed. No packages are installed by this setting.

constraints.validationMessage: Leave blank, or enter the absolute Linux path to the Python executable.

elements.name: managedIdentityClientId
elements.label: VM identity override
elements.toolTip: For multiple user-assigned identities, enter the client ID authorized for this project. Enter system to choose the attached system identity explicitly. An override must be attached to this VM.

constraints.validationMessage: Leave blank, enter system, or enter an attached managed identity client ID (GUID).

elements.name: configurationPath
elements.label: Project settings file override
elements.toolTip: Only needed if more than one project configuration matches. Enter a path relative to the Factory project folder or an absolute path on the VM.

elements.name: projectSubscriptionId
elements.label: Project subscription override
elements.toolTip: Normally leave blank. If supplied, it must match dev_sub_id in the selected variables.json. The project and VM may be in different subscriptions within the same tenant.

constraints.validationMessage: Leave blank or enter the configured project subscription ID.

options.text: Create runs the real deployment and incurs Azure application and model charges, including knowledge-index embeddings. Do not run it concurrently with a project pipeline. No automatic rollback is performed.
